data.name: Gmail: Create Draft
data.description: Create a draft email in Gmail without sending it.
data.instructions:
Create a draft email in Gmail without sending it.

The draft will appear in your Gmail Drafts folder ready for review and sending.

**Inputs:**
- {to}: Recipient email address(es)
- {subject}: Email subject line
- {body}: Email body content

**Output:** {result} contains the created draft details including the draft ID.
